text:
sam.green: Heads-up: SAST flagged rule SNYK-JS-SQL-01 in analytics-service (query builder). Looks like false positive but need consistent triage workflow. cc @maria.kim @elaine.sec

maria.kim: Can you paste the vuln snippet & stack trace? We need repro and PR link to mark fp.

sam.green: Pasted below. It's knex parameterized query, no string concat. Scanner shows rule id + a line number.

snyk-bot: SNYK-ALERT: rule=SNYK-JS-SQL-01 severity=medium path=services/analytics/src/db/query.js line=122

sam.green: Exact snippet:
```js
return db('events').where({ user_id: userId }).andWhere('type', type);
```
No string interpolation.

elaine.sec: Workflow proposal: 1) create GH issue with label `security/sast` 2) attach minimal repro or explain why FP 3) assign to oncall sec reviewer 4) add `scanner:false-positive` label once approved 5) add comment referencing scanner rule id + date 6) update PR template to include `security-review: done` checkbox.

noah.dev: Where should the scan artifacts & raw report live? We should keep them for audits.

maria.kim: Store raw reports in `s3://redwood-security-scans` and push audit entry to audit-logs with viewer RBAC restricted. Use KMS key `arn:aws:kms:region:acct-id:key/CMK-scans` (customer-managed).

sam.green: @maria.kim what's the RBAC for who can mark false-positive? Only sec team or repo owners?

elaine.sec: Only sec triage + repo code owner can mark FP. We'll create `sec-scan-admins` and `sec-scan-readers` groups. `sec-scan-admins` can change labels and close issues; changes recorded in audit-logs. Add note to PR template.

ops-bot: Deploy note: added S3 lifecycle 2y + replication to log-bucket-dl for compliance.

noah.dev: For DAST findings, do we follow same labeling? Many are environment-dependent.

elaine.sec: DAST: create `security/dast` issues; require environment repro steps or screenshots. If it's a flaky false-positive, mark `investigate/dast-flaky` and link monitoring.

maria.kim: I'll add checklist & PR template snippet. Please use this snippet in PR body:
```md
Security review:
- [ ] security/sast scanned
- [ ] security/dast scanned (if applicable)
- [ ] SAST false-positive documented (rule id + explanation)
- [ ] KMS key used for scan artifacts: CMK-scans
```

sam.green: Thanks—I'll create the issue & update PR. If anyone wants to automate marking common FPs, we can add suppression list in scanner config but must still require manual review.

elaine.sec: :thumbsup: sounds good. Assigning to @maria.kim to add docs. I'll schedule a 15-min sync with repo owners tomorrow.
